meta.title: Persona library
meta.description: Keeps a library of named personas and replaces the deployment persona with the one in use. Settings → Persona holds the library: create, rename, edit and delete entries, and pick which one every conversation uses. The chip beside a conversation's title names the persona that conversation actually runs and opens a picker to give it its own, or to turn the persona off for that conversation alone. A conversation that picks its own follows the library entry, so editing that entry reaches it; deleting the entry returns the conversation to the default. Requires dsh 0.2.3 or newer to take effect.
